## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 correctly reports missing inputs, but no bounded ranges from source-30 or source-29 were available or inspected; therefore completeness and status comparison cannot be verified.
- claim-2 is validated but concerns source-6, so it cannot substitute for the requested source-30 extraction or source-29 status evidence.
- The draft explicitly and correctly states that the requested target is **not established**.

## Unresolved certificates
- [source-refresh] Supply citable source-30 excerpts covering every explicitly labelled Conjecture, Question, and Problem, together with sufficient source mapping to establish exhaustiveness.
- [source-refresh] Supply citable source-29 excerpts giving the status of each extracted item, including explicit evidence when source-29 provides no status.
